name: OpenStreetMap website (map links)
tier_rationale: Non-profit foundation with published terms of use and ODbL data (A8; P260 cond 5: 'trusted - ... OpenStreetMap Foundation').

reliability.justification: Manual reverse-image or map pages whose content is third-party or user-generated: reliability cannot be judged at provider level (manual links only).

map_marker.title: OpenStreetMap ?mlat=&mlon= marker links (manual map links)

terms.quote: The pack is offline data (disclosure 'none'): V3LUM never requests these URLs or any API behind them.

map_marker.notes: Research C0615 terms 'ODbL.' (www.openstreetmap.org/?mlat={lat}&mlon={lon}; 200, client-rendered marker; live 2026-11-26). The research template's #map= fragment is replaced by &zoom=18 (P311: the value only in path/query). Coordinates are personal data: privacy links shown only for coordinates already in the case after the analyst opts in (P260 cond 11). Used by pivots_geo_image.

notes: Seeded by batch p2-G12-1 (P260) for the map website only. nominatim.openstreetmap.org (geocoding API, contact UA bound by PROFILE_REQUIREMENTS) is not a host of this provider: a batch that needs it adds its own provider or extends this one.
